sanity_v2.note: Shuffled-pairs baselines computed 20 Aug 2026 from results/embeddings.npz. The original cka_vs_random control used np.random.randn, which is not a valid null: it shares neither the spectrum nor the scale of the embeddings.
sanity_v2.method: row permutation of emb_base, 20 draws, rng seed 42, PCA-384 on both sides
sanity_v2.conclusion: CKA exceeds Procrustes R2 both raw (0.119) and after floor normalization (0.128). The direction of the pilot's finding survives correction. The positive floor is specific to this geometry: n/d = 1.3. On low-dimensional latents with large n the same estimator has a floor near -0.9.
